originalOpportunityRecord.title: Paralegal
originalOpportunityRecord.description:
Why join Giga

  • The Pace: We're building at a speed most companies talk about but never actually operate at. If you've been bored somewhere else, you won't be here.
  • The Impact: Every person at Giga touches the work that matters. No layers, no waiting for approval chains. You'll see your fingerprints on what we ship.
  • The Team: A team of operators defining the future of AI infrastructure. We recruit A-players from the most innovative companies in the world, and they choose Giga because the work here means more.
  • The Moment: AI doesn't run without power, and that's us. Giga is the picks and shovels behind the AI revolution. This industry is about to explode, and you'll be in the room where it's already happening.

What Youâll Do

As Paralegal, youâll take full ownership of the NDA & intake process. Youâll drive NDAs to execution independently, without attorneys needing to be involved. Youâll maintain a centralized legal intake process â a single place where requests come in, get triaged, and get worked â and then hold the rest of the company accountable to using it. Youâll own the signature pipeline end to end: queuing documents, sending them out, and tracking them to completion. This is a highly autonomous role: youâll be given the outcome we need and trusted to enforce the process to get there, adapting as priorities shift.

This role starts as an individual contributor with real scope across every project at Giga, and thereâs a clear path to take on bigger, more complex work as you prove out the process.

Where youâll work

This role is remote. Travel is light â expect roughly 0â10%, mainly for occasional in-person team time.

Responsibilities

  • Own the end-to-end NDA process â draft, negotiate, and drive NDAs to execution independently, escalating to attorneys only on true edge cases.
  • Design and own a centralized legal intake process, replacing todayâs scattered mix of personal email, Slack channels and DMs, and texts with a single, clear front door for legal requests.
  • Triage incoming legal requests â route them appropriately and set expectations on turnaround.
  • Enforce the intake process company-wide: when requests bypass it, redirect requesters back into the right workflow, including on Daveâs behalf.
  • Manage the full signature pipeline â queue documents, send for e-signature, and track them to completion.
  • Maintain and organize the contract repository so agreements are easy to find, track, and report on.
  • Partner with attorneys and business teams to keep the legal function organized and responsive as request volume grows.
  • Take on larger, higher-complexity projects as you build trust and track record in the role.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience as a paralegal or in a similar legal operations role.
  • Experience independently managing NDAs from drafting through execution.
  • Experience building, running, or significantly improving a legal intake or triage process.
  • Working knowledge of e-signature tools, contract repositories, and contract lifecycle management (CLM) tools.
  • Ability to work autonomously with minimal oversight, exercising sound judgment on when to escalate to attorneys.
  • Comfortable enforcing process consistently while staying flexible as priorities and workflows shift.

Bonus points

  • Paralegal certificate.
  • 10+ years of experience in a legal operations or paralegal role.
  • Experience standing up legal intake or operations processes from scratch.
  • Experience supporting legal teams at a high-growth or fast-paced company.
  • Experience preparing legal notes or executive briefs.

Benefits

  • Subsidized health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Equity (options) in a rapidly growing startup
  • 401(k) with 4% employer match
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Parental leave
  • Healthcare and Dependent Care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) or Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Commuter benefits
  • Monthly team on-sites where all offices come in-person to collaborate

Who We Hire

We hire people who thrive in chaos and get sharper under pressure. You don't wait to be told what to do, you spot the gap and fill it. When there's work to be done, you do it. You make decisions with the information you have, move fast, and adjust along the way. We're not looking for perfect; we're looking for people who get things done.

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement

Giga Energy is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Giga Energy complies with all applicable labor laws, including the California Fair Employment and Housing Act (FEHA) and other relevant state and federal regulations. We provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and encourage applicants who require accommodations during the hiring process to contact us.

originalOpportunityRecord.description:
About the Company

 

e.l.f. Beauty, Inc. stands with every eye, lip, face, paw and fin. Our deep commitment to clean, cruelty free beauty at an incredible value has fueled the success of our flagship brand e.l.f. Cosmetics since 2004 and driven our portfolio expansion. Today, our multi-brand portfolio includes e.l.f. Cosmetics, e.l.f. SKIN, Well People - clean beauty powered by plants, Naturium - high-performance, biocompatible, clinically-effective and accessible skin care, and our newest brand, rhode skin - developed by Hailey Rhode Bieber, a line of curated skincare essentials, formulated for a variety of skin types and needs with high performance ingredients, itâs a daily routine that nourishes your skin barrier over time

 

In our Fiscal year 26, we had net sales of $1.6 Billion and our business performance has been nothing short of extraordinary with 29 consecutive quarters of net sales growth. We are the #2 mass cosmetics brand in the US and are the fastest growing mass cosmetics brand among the top 5. Our total compensation philosophy offers every full-time new hire competitive pay and benefits, bonus eligibility (200% of target over the last seven fiscal years), equity, flexible time off, year-round half-day Fridays, and a hybrid 3 day in office, 2 day at home work environment. We believe the combination of our unique culture, total compensation, workplace flexibility and care for the team is unmatched across not just beauty but any industry. 

 

Visit our Career Page to learn more about our team: https://www.elfbeauty.com/work-with-us


The Manager, International Customer Supply Chain will play a key role in delivering an exceptional customer and retail partner experience across rhodeâs growing international business. This role will partner closely with Sales, Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Finance, Operations, international distributors and retail partners to ensure strong execution across order management, inventory flow, launch planning, and ongoing customer supply chain performance. This role will support multiple international markets and distribution partners, requiring strong coordination across regions and global supply chain processes.

This is a highly cross-functional role that requires strong analytical skills, clear communication, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where processes are still being built. The ideal candidate is proactive, solutions-oriented, and comfortable moving between day-to-day execution and longer-term process improvement.

A core focus of this role will be building strong relationships with key retail partners, understanding their supply chain requirements, supporting innovation and promotional planning, identifying and mitigating supply risks, and using customer data to improve in-stocks, fulfillment, and overall service levels.

\n


What You'll Do

  • Serve as a key point of contact between rhode and international distributors and retail customer operations teams, supporting day-to-day execution and market-specific supply chain needs

  •  Continually assess opportunities to improve customer supply chain, reduce operational costs, and drive volume through supply chain metrics

  • Develop a deep understanding of each international distributor and retail partnerâs distribution model, operational requirements, key metrics, and inventory planning needs

  • Strong analytical skills to produce qualitative/quantitative data (using Excel, PowerPoint, NetSuite, Tableau) that can be shared to drive business

  • Broad understanding of policies, processes and systems relating to retail distributor operations

  • Overseeing and ensuring smooth order processing and timely delivery across international customers, distributors, and retail partners with focus on Innovation planning and customer expansion

  • Provide weekly sell in data vs. forecast and any risks associated to the month/quarter plan to Finance, Sales and Operations stakeholders

  • Track & monitor weekly sell out data coupled with retailer in stock levels in partnership with Demand planning and Sales account leads

  • As needed, partner with international distributors, retailer Supply Chain & planning teams to drive additional orders or forecast adjustments guaranteeing appropriate inventory coverage

  • Track and report on key international customer supply chain KPIs, including fulfillment, in-stocks, service levels, on-time delivery, and potential chargeback risk

  • Internal and external collaboration for alignment and identifying opportunities

  • Participate and contribute to customer demand forecasting, maximizing forecast accuracy

  • Participate and influence assortment decisions aimed at optimizing sales and productivity by utilizing analytics, market research, consumer research, and customer intelligence

  • Partner closely with international teams, distributors, and cross-functional stakeholders to support new market launches, regional assortment expansion, and ongoing operational excellence.

  • Ability to connect internal functions to drive supply chain improvements (fill rate, on-time, in-stocks, reduce potential chargebacks, customer program execution) for the customer

  • Help educate and align internal teams on international customer expectations, distributor requirements, regional retailer requirements, and best practices for execution


What You'll Bring

  • Bachelorâs degree in Supply Chain or another analytical field preferred or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years of experience in customer supply chain, retail operations, customer logistics, demand planning, supply planning, or related operational roles

  • Must have experience with Sephora and/or other global prestige beauty retailers

  • Experience supporting international retailers, distributors, or global customer supply chain operations.

  • Strong communication skills both verbal and written

  • Excellent Excel Skills and knowledge

  • Proven ability to build strong relationships with retail partners, internal cross-functional teams and deliver results

  • Ability to make thoughtful decisions when data is limited, ambiguous, or evolving

  • Experience managing multiple countries, distributors, or regional supply chain requirements 

  • Willingness to travel internationally is required


Other Details for Consideration

  • Travel Expectation: Must be willing to travel internationally for the business and to our HQ when needed

originalOpportunityRecord.title: Onboarding Specialist
originalOpportunityRecord.description:
INNERGY is transforming the woodworking industry with purpose built, cloud based ERP software designed exclusively for custom manufacturers. Our platform helps businesses operate smarter, faster, and more efficiently while seamlessly connecting design, production, and delivery for teams creating architectural millwork, cabinetry, and casework.

What truly sets INNERGY apart is our people. Founded in 2016, we are a globally distributed team of 200 plus professionals united by deep software expertise and a shared passion for solving meaningful, real world problems. We value collaboration, creativity, and ownership, and we are intentional about building not only powerful products, but also a culture where people feel supported, heard, and inspired to do their best work.

With strong momentum and the recent acquisition of Microvellum, a trusted leader in design to manufacturing solutions for the woodworking industry, INNERGY is entering an exciting new phase of growth. This combination expands our capabilities, deepens our industry impact, and accelerates our vision of delivering a truly connected, end to end platform for custom manufacturers.

As we scale thoughtfully and bring together top talent and new perspectives, this is a unique opportunity to join a company where your work will have visible impact, your ideas will help shape decisions, and your contributions will play a meaningful role in defining the future of a fast evolving product, team, and industry.

Job Description

In this role, you will guide clients through our structured onboarding process, ensuring they adopt INNERGY effectively and achieve measurable business value early in their journey.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Client Onboarding: Manage the onboarding process for new clients by setting clear expectations, defining milestones, and tracking progress against onboarding goals.
  • Education & Enablement: Support client education by integrating learning opportunities into onboarding and collaborating with the Content Creation team to prioritize and request the training resources clients need most.
  • Process Monitoring: Use data and progress tracking to monitor client health during onboarding, identifying and addressing potential challenges early.
  • Client Motivation: Keep clients engaged and motivated throughout onboarding, encouraging adoption of INNERGY processes and best practices.
  • Communication: Maintain clear, consistent communication with clients, providing regular updates and documenting all interactions for cross-team visibility.
  • Problem Solving: Identify and address challenges such as limited client engagement or resistance to change. Develop strategies to overcome these obstacles and keep onboarding on track.
  • Feedback Loop: Gather client feedback throughout onboarding and share insights to help refine onboarding strategies and influence future training content priorities.

Qualifications

  • Experience in onboarding, client success, or related roles, preferably within Microvellum architectural millwork industry, or manufacturing.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts clearly.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills.
  • Ability to analyze data and use insights to manage progress and risks.
  • Skilled at motivating and guiding clients toward successful outcomes.
  • Experience collaborating with content or training teams to prioritize and influence resource development.
  • Problem-solving mindset with adaptability to client needs and challenges.
  • Travel up to 10%

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Accessibility & Work Environment

INNERGY is committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace. We support reasonable adjustments for individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you require any accommodations during the recruitment process or in your role, please let us know.

This role is primarily computer-based and may involve extended periods of screen time and frequent communication through digital tools. Work may be performed remotely or in an office setting, depending on the role and location. We prioritize employee wellbeing, flexibility, and a safe, supportive work environment across all regions.

Equal Opportunity Employer

INNERGY is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values diversity at every level of the organization. We are committed to creating a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

Location Eligibility Notice

This is a U.S.-based remote role. Due to current regulatory requirements, we are only able to consider candidates residing in certain U.S. states.

Eligible states include, but are not limited to: Texas, Florida, Missouri, Arizona, Indiana, North Carolina, and Wisconsin.

At this time, candidates located in California, Colorado, New York, Illinois, Washington, or other states with active pay transparency requirements are not eligible for consideration.

originalOpportunityRecord.title: Animal Cruelty Case Specialist
originalOpportunityRecord.description:
Description

Term of Employment: Full-Time, Exempt

Reports To: Criminal Justice Program Managing Attorney

Union: Bargaining Unit Position, Nonprofit Professional Employees Union (NPEU)

Location: Remote (U.S. Based)

Who We Are

The Animal Legal Defense Fundâs mission is to protect the lives and advance the interests of animals through the legal system. The Animal Legal Defense Fund accomplishes this mission by filing high-impact lawsuits to protect animals from harm, providing free legal assistance and training to prosecutors to assure that animal abusers are held accountable for their crimes, supporting tough animal protection legislation and fighting legislation harmful to animals, gathering data about and advocating for effective regulation of animal exploitative industries and providing resources and opportunities to law students and professionals to advance the emerging field of animal law.

Role Description

The Criminal Justice Program (CJP) Animal Cruelty Case Specialist position furthers the mission of the Animal Legal Defense Fund (ALDF) to protect the lives and advance the interests of animals through the legal system, by providing prosecutors, law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues with essential operational and forensic support on criminal animal cruelty cases and encouraging the investigation and prosecution of animal crimes to ensure justice for animal victims. The CJP Animal Cruelty Case Specialist triages all incoming reports of animal cruelty and maintains the active case database. The Animal Cruelty Case Specialist applies their experience and expertise to in-depth case-related research and to the training of key stakeholders. This position acts as a liaison across ALDFâs programs to disseminate approved case response information in a timely and responsible manner. The Animal Cruelty Case Specialist is accountable for the day-to-day management of their assigned cases and projects.

How You Will Make a Difference

Case Support

  • Receive reports of animal cruelty and requests for case assistance from professional stakeholders, the Administrative Manager, and other sources. Provide initial responses and triage via phone or email.
  • Exercise discretion in analyzing and recommending which cases CJP chooses to pursue, including communicating efficiently with complainants and advocates by phone and email; gathering relevant facts (through eyewitness accounts, media reports, and other sources as needed) for potential criminal cruelty cases; and identifying, after thorough independent analysis, those cases warranting further investigation and/or veterinary forensics.
  • Generate and categorize cases, and work with Managing Attorneys to assign cases to CJP staff according to department protocols. Ensure that complete and accurate case information is relayed in a timely fashion to the appropriate team members.
  • Input and access information using automated systems, make entries into automated record files, seek to maximize use of automated systems available to CJP to further efficiency and accuracy in case response and record keeping.
  • Maintain and organize all case-related records and documentation in a timely, logical, and confidential manner. Ensure that electronic logs of all legal cases are accurate and current. Review case notes to maintain consistent and timely response in all cases.
  • Conduct internet research on potential/active cases (i.e. Facebook, social media, news sources, and company websites). Provide basic assistance in research projects, special reports, and case information gathering. Prepare materials for meetings, court proceedings, and case discovery.
  • Follow up with professional stakeholders on case outcomes/resolutions where possible. Create and maintain a system for tracking date and time of upcoming court proceedings related to CJP-assisted cases.
  • Manage CJP grant processing for expert witnesses, forensic testing, and costs of care in criminal cases, coordinating with internal and external individuals as needed.
  • Inform and assist law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues on animal cruelty case investigations and case strategies, including reviewing and advising on interview tactics, department policies and procedures, veterinary exams and reports, protective custody foster care programs and related agreements, and large-scale animal rescue implementation.
  • Participate in deployment to crime scenes and rescues as needed, exercising discretion in both the decision to travel on-site and the orchestration of such activities.
  • Assist with hands-on scene processing for animal cruelty cases, including identifying, collecting and packaging evidence; assisting with logistics and operational expertise; and assisting with other aspects of search and seizure operations and animal rescue support.
  • Provide support as requested to CJP Case Response Unit.

External Relationship Building and Outreach

  • Build strategic relationships with prosecutors, law enforcement, animal control, veterinarians, and animal rescues to facilitate agency assistance in forensics, crime scene processing, and veterinary medicine.
  • Schedule and conduct outreach and training presentations for various disciplines, including but not limited to law enforcement agencies, veterinarians, prosecutors, animal shelters and rescues, and social service agencies.

Internal Relationship Building

  • Proactively maintain intradepartmental relationships and act as a liaison to other programs.
  • Create and maintain system for sharing information about CJP case work and outcomes across departments and facilitate the sharing of information approved for public-facing materials.
  • Provide in-house expertise for staff on questions concerning Criminal Justice Program cases, animal cruelty cases in general, criminal investigation, veterinary forensics, animal rescue and sheltering.

Please note, this job description is not intended to be a comprehensive list of all duties and responsibilities of the position, which are subject to change in order to best advance ALDFâs strategic objectives and mission.

Requirements

We Are Looking for Candidates With:

  • A bachelorâs degree in a related field desired; or 5 years equivalent work experience accepted in lieu of.
  • At least 3 years of experience in enforcement fieldwork operations, animal cruelty response, dispatch, and/or criminal case management.
  • Demonstrated veterinary forensics or animal cruelty enforcement expertise, including but not limited to, retaining related certifications in the field (such as Certificate in Veterinary Forensics, NACA certifications, FEMA certification, Property and Evidence Certifications, Police or Humane Officer certification).
  • The ability to handle sensitive and confidential information and materials according to the highest standards of confidentiality, chain of custody, and ethical conduct and exercise discretion in the use of related materials and information.
  • Excellent organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to meet deadlines.
  • Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate effectively with colleagues, organizational members and supporters, members of the public, and others. A positive attitude, ability to work cooperatively with others, and ability to function well in a team-oriented work environment.
  • Comfort speaking in public to audiences of various sizes and demographics.
  • The ability to maintain composure and lead others in times of heightened urgency or stress.
  • An understanding of and full commitment to the vision, mission, and core values of the Animal Legal Defense Fund.
  • The ability to travel frequently to conferences, trainings, meetings, and other events as required; estimated 5-7 events per year.

We Offer Competitive Compensation With Excellent Benefits, Including

  • Starting annual salary of $71,509 for most geographic locations.
  • For candidates located within 25 miles of Washington D.C., Cotati, CA, and Los Angeles, starting pay is $75,273.
  • For candidates located within 25 miles of New York City and San Francisco, starting pay is $79,036.

To ensure salary equity, we do not negotiate salary outside of the published starting rate. Rate is determined by role, using set geographical factors.

  • Comprehensive health care, dental, life and vision benefits (100% employer paid); Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Dependent Care Account (DCA) are also available
  • 192 hours of PTO
  • 19 paid holidays
  • 1-month paid sabbatical after 5 years of continuous employment
  • 16 weeks paid parental leave
  • 401k plan with a maximum 5% employer contribution match after one year of employment
  • Alternative work schedules (at managerâs discretion)
  • One-time remote work allowance of $750
  • Annual professional development reimbursement of up to $1,000.

Maintaining a healthy work/life balance is a core value for the Animal Legal Defense Fund.

Additional Information

This role is included in a collective bargaining unit that is represented by the Nonprofit Professional Employees Union (NPEU). Certain terms and conditions of your employment, including wages and benefits, have been negotiated with the Union and are included in a collective bargaining agreement between ALDF and the Union.

This is a U.S. based position. In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire.

The Animal Legal Defense Fund (ALDF) is an equal opportunity employer and committed to providing an employment environment which is welcoming of persons from diverse backgrounds and free from unlawful discrimination and harassment, and in which all legal rights of our employees are recognized and protected. ALDF conducts all internal and external operations, programs, and employment-related decision making (including hiring decisions) without regard to actual or perceived race, ancestry, color, religion, national origin, citizenship, immigration status, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, political affiliation, disability or medical condition (including physical, intellectual, or psychiatric), sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, age, or other protected category, and in compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination and anti-harassment laws.

Consistent with the organizationâs mission, our offices and events are free of animal products and byproducts.

originalOpportunityRecord.description:

About UFC GYM

UFC GYM is the first major brand extension of UFC, the world's premier mixed martial arts organization. As the pioneer of MMA-inspired fitness, UFC GYM offers members access to world-class training programs, group fitness classes, personal and small-group training, and youth programming across corporate and franchise locations worldwide. Our brand lives at the intersection of combat sports, fitness, and community and our marketing team brings that energy to life every day.

Position Overview

UFC GYM is seeking a Junior Designer to join our in-house marketing team. Reporting to the Lead Designer, this role supports the creative execution of brand campaigns, member acquisition initiatives, new club openings, and field marketing programs across our corporate and franchise network. This is a hands-on production and design role â ideal for a creative who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes direction well, and is excited to grow within a globally recognized fitness brand.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Design & Production

  • Create original graphic designs supporting company initiatives, including promotions, member acquisition campaigns, events, partnerships, and internal communications
  • Take approved concepts and designs from the Lead Designer and scale a single design across multiple formats, sizes, and channels (digital display, social, email, in-club signage, print collateral)
  • Ensure all creative output adheres to UFC GYM brand standards, templates, and style guidelines
  • Prepare print-ready and web-optimized files with accurate specs, bleeds, and color profiles


New Club Openings & Remodels

  • Develop and execute gym graphics plans for new club openings and remodels, including wall graphics, wayfinding, window clings, and environmental branding
  • Coordinate with vendors, printers, and field teams to ensure accurate production and installation of location graphics


Asset Management

  • Upload, organize, and maintain creative assets within the company's asset management platform, ensuring files are current, properly named, and accessible to corporate and franchise stakeholders
  • Support the marketing team in fulfilling creative asset requests from franchise locations and field teams


Team Support

  • Participate in creative briefings, provide production timelines, and manage multiple concurrent projects against deadlines
  • Support photo and video needs for events, club openings, and content capture as needed


Required Qualifications

  • 1â3 years of graphic design experience (agency, in-house, or strong portfolio of freelance/academic work)
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (CC)
  • Proficiency in Canva and Figma
  • Experience working with Dropbox or similar cloud-based file management systems
  • Strong understanding of design fundamentals: typography, layout, hierarchy, and color
  • Ability to work within an established brand system and follow creative direction
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple projects and shifting priorities
  • Portfolio required with application


Preferred Qualifications

  • Photography, videography, and video editing skills (Premiere Pro, After Effects, CapCut or equivalent) â highly preferred
  • Experience with large-format print production and environmental graphics
  • Familiarity with fitness, sports, or lifestyle brands
  • Experience supporting multi-location or franchise organizations
  • Motion graphics or animation experience


Benefits

  • Full-time position with benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Complimentary UFC GYM membership
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Growth opportunity within a global fitness brand


We empower the fighting spirit in you!

This is a remote position.

This franchise is independently owned and operated by a franchisee. Your application will go directly to the franchisee, and all hiring decisions will be made by the management of this franchisee. All inquiries about employment at this franchisee should be made directly to the franchise location, and not to UFC Gym.

originalOpportunityRecord.title: Vice President Field Services
originalOpportunityRecord.description:
Who we areâ¦

Verra Mobility is a global leader in smart mobility. We develop technology-enabled solutions that help the world move safely and easily. We are fostering the development of safe cities, working with police departments and municipalities to install over 10,000 red-light, speed, and school bus stop arm safety cameras across North America. We are also creating smart roadways, serving the world's largest commercial fleets and rental car companies to manage tolling transactions and violations for over 8.5 million vehicles. And we are a leading provider of connected systems, processing nearly 165 million transactions each year across 50+ individual tolling authorities.

â¯

What you'll be doingâ¦

As Vice President, Field Services, you will be a visionary and strategic leader responsible for orchestrating the success of our North American Field Services organization. You will oversee regional field operations, the Remote Technical Support Team (Command Center) department, Fleet Management, driving operational excellence, innovation, and scalability across a complex network of internal teams and third-party partners. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of field services, balancing long-term strategy with hands-on execution. Your leadership will be essential in transforming operations through data-driven decision-making, continuous improvement, and a relentless focus on customer experience and cost control.

â¯

  • Lead and evolve the Field Services organization, including internal teams and third-party vendors, to deliver consistent, high-quality service across the U.S. and Canada.
  • Oversee Command Center operations to ensure real-time monitoring, incident response, problem management, and service continuity.
  • Direct Fleet Management strategy, optimizing asset utilization, maintenance, and lifecycle planning.
  • Manage multiple operational P&Ls, including forecasting, budgeting, and performance tracking.
  • Champion a customer-focused culture and lead change management initiatives that align with enterprise goals.
  • Develop and execute strategic plans across people, processes, and technology to support growth and scalability.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify and resolve operational challenges, improve service delivery, and enhance field technician support.
  • Apply continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean and Six Sigma to streamline processes and reduce defects.
  • Monitor key performance indicators and use data analytics to drive decision-making and operational enhancements.
  • Represent Field Services in executive forums, contributing to enterprise-wide strategy and planning.
  • Other duties as assigned.

What we're looking forâ¦

You are a visionary and strategic leader with a proven ability to scale and transform complex operations while driving service excellence across diverse teams and geographies. You bring a strong command of operational strategy, financial acumen, and performance management, paired with a deep understanding of field services, command center operations, and fleet management. Your communication skills enable you to influence and align stakeholders at all levels, while your analytical mindset supports data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement. You thrive in dynamic environments, lead through change with confidence, and foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and customer focus.



You'll need to have:

  • BS/BA degree required
  • 7+ years of experience leading Field Services operations
  • 7+ years of experience leading Remote Technical Support (Command Center) operations
  • 2+ years of experience leading Fleet Management operations
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed teams across North America or globally.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide initiatives at the executive level, including demonstrated skills ranging from work direction, motivation, coaching/feedback, and developing assigned staff with the expected outcome of consistently positive client experience and SLA attainment.
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, ability to take the initiative, use good judgment, demonstrate a strong sense of urgency and follow-up, and carry multiple projects through to completion.
  • Qualified candidates will possess exceptional statistical/analytical skills, exemplary problem-solving abilities, and show initiative to get ahead of potential out-of-compliance processes .
  • Proven track record of building and maintaining good internal and external working relationships.
  • Demonstrated business process engineering/re-engineering experience using Six Sigma, Lean, or other formal process improvement methodology.
  • Excellent verbal/written communication and presentation skills, including a collaborative management style.

â¯

Even better if you have one or more of the following:

  • MBA or Master's in Operations Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • Lean Six Sigma Training and Certification (Green belt or Black belt)
  • PMP (Project Management Professional)
  • ITIL4 Certification
  • Experience in the photo enforcement industry

â¯

Where you'll be workingâ¦



In this remote role, you'll have the flexibility to work from home full-time, allowing you to create an optimal work environment. You'll also have regular check-ins and team meetings scheduled through virtual platforms to ensure collaboration and support. This role requires up to 50% travel across North America to engage with teams, oversee operations, and support strategic initiatives.

Aligned with Verra Mobility Values

  • Do What's Right â We've committed to doing the right thing for each other and for our customers â integrity is our DNA
  • Lead With Grace â We embrace the importance of our colleagues and customers and always treat them with kindness and grace.
  • Own It â We foster a culture of accountability and excellence, where going the extra mile is standard practice.
  • Win Together â We are ambitious and like to win, but we know we win more when we include others and work together.



Verra Mobility Values



An ideal candidate for this role naturally works in alignment with the Verra Mobility Core Values:

  • Own It. We focus on high performance and drive toward breakthrough outcomes. Our employees ensure accountability, optimize and align work, focus on the customer, and cultivate innovation.
  • Do What's Right. We champion integrity and good character. Our team members model ethical behavior, demonstrate good judgment and are courageous.
  • Choose Courage Over Comfort. We lean into the conversations, decisions and actions that move the business forward, even when they feel uncomfortable. We challenge assumptions, address issues early and prioritize progress over ease.
  • Win Together. We believe in growing and inspiring people together. We seek people who collaborate, value differences, think and act globally, foster an engaging work environment, and recognize and develop others.



With your explicit consent which you provided as part of the application process, we will retain candidate personal data solely for the business purpose for which it was collected. In no event will we retain such data more than two (2) years following the closure of the recruitment process relating to the role for which you applied or in the event other related job opportunities arise within the company. Verra Mobility Applicant Privacy Notice

Verra Mobility is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.

originalOpportunityRecord.title: Director of Customer Experience
originalOpportunityRecord.description:
About us

LifeMD is a leading provider of virtual primary care, telehealth, and specialized treatment programs serving hundreds of thousands of patients nationwide. Our vertically integrated platform combines 50-state licensed providers, in-house pharmacy and lab integrations, and proprietary technology that enables safe, high-quality, and affordable care.

At the heart of this transformation is our team of developers, engineers, and tech innovators building state-of-the-art systems that make healthcare smarter, faster, and more accessible. From architecting scalable backend systems to crafting intuitive user experiences, we are pushing boundaries every day.

Recognized as one of the fastest-growing healthcare tech companies (#166 on Deloitte Fast 500 in 2023), LifeMD is not just a healthcare company â it's a tech company revolutionizing healthcare.

About the role

LifeMD is seeking a strategic, data-obsessed Director of Customer Experience to lead and elevate our remote customer operations. This role sits at the intersection of technology, clinical empathy, and operational excellence. We are looking for someone who has built and continuously evolved high-performing, technology-enabled CX organizations; deploying AI voice and chat tools, engineering data-driven performance cultures, and creating differentiated, concierge-level experiences that drive loyalty and growth.

Reporting directly to the SVP of Operations & Patient Experience, you will translate the executive team's vision and strategy into operational reality,surfacing the voice of the customer, driving measurable performance, and partnering cross-functionally to embed customer insights into decisions across the organization. If you thrive in fast-moving health tech environments and believe exceptional customer experience is a commercial advantage, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Remote Contact Center Leadership

  • Lead, scale, and continuously optimize a remote contact center team across multiple channels (voice, chat, email, SMS). Setting KPIs, driving performance expectations, and driving continuous improvement.
  • Set and enforce service level standards, workforce management practices, scheduling, capacity models, and escalation protocols
  • Build a high-accountability, coaching-first culture across team leads and frontline agents

Customer Experience

  • Develop and maintain service blueprints and experience standards across contact and service touchpoints that transform support from a transactional function into a driver of loyalty and advocacy
  • Champion a culture of empathy, accountability, and customer-centricity across the entire CX organization

AI & Technology Integration

  • Own the performance of AI-powered support functions including AI voice (conversational IVR), chatbots, and agent-assist tools â monitoring deflection rates, containment quality, sentiment signals, and escalation patterns
  • Partner with Product and Engineering to evaluate, implement, and iterate on AI tooling that augments agent performance and improves resolution rates without sacrificing human connection
  • Ensure deep integration between CX technology and broader customer-facing platforms including EHR, CRM, and marketing automation systems
  • â¢ Stay current on emerging customer support technologies and serve as the internal subject matter expert on responsible AI use within a healthcare context

Data-Driven Performance Management

  • Define, track, and improve core CX metrics: first contact resolution, average handle time, CSAT, NPS, escalation rate, AI containment rate, retention, and reactivation
  • Monitor NPS trends surfaced through the CX function and partner with the Manager of Patient Experience to close the loop on customer feedback and drive operational improvements
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reporting cadences that provide real-time operational visibility to your team and to the SVP
  • Conduct root cause analysis on performance gaps and translate findings into structured improvement plans
  • Synthesize customer insights, VOC data, and operational trends into clear, executive-ready briefings

Commercial Impact & Customer Lifecycle

  • Align CX operations with revenue and retention goals, connecting CSAT, NPS, and resolution metrics to commercial outcomes including retention, upsell conversion, and reactivation
  • Identify patterns in customer friction that represent risk to renewal, referral, or acquisition, and advocate for fixes cross-functionally
  • Support onboarding and activation workflows that reduce time-to-value; contribute to behavioral engagement and churn prediction strategies

Quality Assurance

  • Design and maintain a rigorous QA framework covering interaction quality, compliance, empathy standards, and clinical accuracy
  • Establish calibration processes across QA reviewers to ensure scoring consistency and fairness
  • Use QA insights to inform targeted coaching, training curricula, and process improvement

Budget Management

  • Manage the CX department budget within parameters, including headcount planning, vendor contracts, and technology spend
  • Identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising service quality or customer outcomes; present trade-off analyses and recommendations

Remote Transition & Operational Build-Out

  • Lead the operational transition to a fully remote customer service model, owning the end-to-end migration across people, process, technology, and compliance workstreams
  • Partner with HR, IT, Legal, and Operations to execute the transition with minimal disruption to the customer experience, establishing remote workforce policies and tooling standards
  • Use the transition as an opportunity to redesign foundational processes and eliminate legacy inefficiencies

Team Leadership & Development

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a high-performing team of managers, team leads, QA specialists, trainers, and agents
  • Build workforce planning, career pathing, and succession pipelines within the CX organization
  • Design the management rhythms, coaching frameworks, and recognition programs that attract and retain top talent in a fully remote environment

Cross-Functional Partnership & Internal Alignment

  • Serve as a key operational partner to the Manager of Patient Experience, ensuring alignment between customer-facing service operations and the broader patient experience program
  • Collaborate closely with the Manager of Patient Experience to align on messaging touchpoints, technology integrations, and shared data â recognizing that the customer journey spans both functions and requires active coordination to deliver a coherent experience
  • Support the SVP of Operations & Patient Experience in executing the overall CX vision, roadmap, and resource planning
  • Collaborate with Product, Clinical, Marketing, Sales, and Finance to embed the customer perspective in upstream decisions
  • Prepare structured insights, trend analyses, and investment recommendations for the SVP to carry into executive forums

Requirements

  • 7+ years of progressive CX, contact center, or customer operations leadership experience, with direct people management responsibility
  • Demonstrated experience leading remote or distributed teams of 50 or more across multiple channels and functions
  • Hands-on experience implementing or managing AI/automation in a customer service context (chatbots, conversational IVR, agent-assist tools)
  • Strong analytical skills â comfortable building dashboards, interpreting performance data, and translating insights into operational action
  • Proven track record connecting CX performance to commercial outcomes including retention, reactivation, and revenue
  • Experience managing vendor relationships including BPO partners and technology providers
  • Experience building or maturing QA programs in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a department budget, including headcount, vendor, and technology spend

Preferred

  • Background in health tech, digital health, telehealth, or healthcare services
  • Familiarity with HIPAA requirements as they apply to CX operations, technology platforms, and data handling
  • Experience with platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Zendesk, Five9, Genesys, or similar CRM/WFM tools
  • Exposure to customer and patient experience frameworks (e.g., service blueprinting, NPS program design, churn prediction models)
  • Background in a direct-to-consumer or subscription-based business where CX plays a direct role in lifetime value

Benefits

  • Health Care Plan (Medical, Dental & Vision)
  • Retirement Plans
  • Life Insurance (Basic, Voluntary & AD&D)
  • Flexible PTO Policy
  • Paid Holidays
  • Short Term Disability
  • Training & Development

Dedicated to delivering exceptional service and maintaining organized business operations, our company is seeking a detail-oriented Administrative Data Entry File Clerk to join our team. If you excel at managing records, entering data accurately, and working independently in a remote environment, this opportunity may be the perfect fit for you.

In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining digital files, updating databases, organizing administrative records, and ensuring information is entered accurately and efficiently. Your attention to detail, reliability, and commitment to data accuracy will play an important role in supporting daily operations and helping our team stay organized and productive.

Â 

Key responsibilities:

Â 

Intake & indexing.

  • Receive files from shared inboxes, portals, internal ticketing tools, and cloud folders.
  • Confirm document type, required fields, signatures, and attachments.
  • Index each record using standard metadata (client/project ID, date, document category, version, region).

Â 

Document organization.

  • Apply standardized naming conventions and folder structures.
  • Convert formats when needed (PDF merge/split, image-to-PDF, compressing, version labeling).
  • Maintain controlled libraries (final vs draft vs archived), including retention tags.

Â 

Quality control

  • Perform daily spot checks for duplicates, misfiles, missing pages, and unreadable scans.
  • Flag exceptions and route them to the correct owner with clear notes.
  • Maintain error logs and contribute to process improvements that reduce rework.

Â 

Records governance & compliance

  • Handle sensitive records with strict access controls and confidentiality.
  • Follow retention schedules, legal hold instructions, and deletion/archival rules.
  • Support audits by pulling records quickly and documenting chain-of-custody steps.

Â 

Collaboration & communication.

Coordinate with HR, Finance, Operations, Legal, or Customer teams to clarify file requirements.

Provide status updates on backlog, turnaround time, and issues found during processing.

Â 

Tools you may use:

Â 

  • Cloud storage (Google Drive/SharePoint/Dropbox), document tools (Adobe Acrobat or equivalents), spreadsheets, ticketing (Jira/Asana/ServiceNow), e-signature platforms, and basic office productivity tools.
  • Success metrics (examples):
  • Accuracy rate (misfile/metadata error rate)
  • Turnaround time from receipt to filed
  • Backlog size and daily throughput
  • Audit retrieval speed and completeness
  • Compliance adherence (access control, retention tagging)

Â 

Qualifications:

Â 

  • Experience in records management, admin support, clerical work, or document control (preferred).
  • Strong attention to detail; able to follow naming/filing rules consistently.
  • Comfortable handling confidential information and following strict procedures.
  • Basic computer proficiency: file systems, spreadsheets, PDFs, and collaboration tools.
